items.title: 68251_Teddy McRae oral history interview
items.q: The transcript mentions 'pet Reck' in the interviewer's prose, but the interviewee (Teddy McRae) does not mention him or describe any personal interaction.

ctx.x: And why I say Ben was always a pet Reck's bad boy, because he'll get in an argument with somebody. We'd all standing around there talking about music, you know.
And Ben would start getting in an argument, and everybody look around and Ben is gone. The guy, "He start an argument and he done walked away." You know,he walked away and leave us.
